name: Don't Smash Into Obstacles
author: Mateusz Czarnecki
description: A simple runner: jump over the obstacles coming your way and try not to smash into them to keep your score climbing.

descriptions.en: A simple runner: jump over the obstacles coming your way and try not to smash into them to keep your score climbing.
descriptions.it: Un semplice runner: salta gli ostacoli che ti vengono incontro senza schiantarti, per far crescere il punteggio.
